reviews.text: i love the texture, it's fit for all skin tone, i can use besfore makeup it help more brigthening, and more smoother. this fav sunb tone up cream. pls double cleaning when use this suncream to prevent skin from blackhead and white head.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意個質地，啱所有膚色用，我可以喺化妝之前用，幫助提亮、令皮膚更加滑。呢款係我最愛嘅防曬提亮霜。用呢款防曬霜嗰陣，請做雙重潔面，以防皮膚長黑頭同白頭。

reviews.text: La primera ves q lo use, sentí como si mi piel al principio de la aplicación se pusiera roja, maybe sea por la fragancia, a las pieles sensibles no les caería tan bien pienso yo, pero fuera de esa reacción me encanta, funciona como prebase 🫶🏻
reviews.zh: 我第一次用嗰陣，搽嘅一開始，覺得皮膚好似變紅咗，可能係因為香味，我諗敏感皮膚可能唔係咁啱，不過除咗嗰個反應之外，我好鍾意，佢可以用作妝前底霜 🫶🏻

reviews.text: I want to love it because I am looking for my favorite mineral sun screen but unfortunately as every mineral the white cast is there. At least I don't feel it on my skin or it doesn't sting my eyes unlike other references I have tried, but it's not there yet. After a good minute of rubbing it, it eventually looks good but I am very fair so
reviews.zh: 我好想鍾意呢款，因為我一直都想搵我最愛嘅礦物防曬，但係好可惜，好似所有礦物防曬一樣，有白色痕跡。至少我唔覺得皮膚有負擔，又冇刺痛我嘅眼睛，唔似我試過嘅其他產品，但係仲未夠好。搓咗一大陣之後，最終睇落都幾好，不過我嘅膚色好白，所以……

reviews.text: Este protector solar es Perfecto para unificar el tono de la piel ya que tiene ingredientes que ayudan a minimizar las manchas además de tener un subtono rosado que le da una apariencia fresca y saludable a la piel con un acabado luminoso , su textura es ligera y perfecta para aplicar maquillaje encima de el.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬好啱用嚟統一膚色，因為佢有成分可以幫助減淡色斑，而且有粉紅色調，令皮膚有清新、健康嘅感覺，帶有光澤嘅效果。質地輕盈，好啱喺上面搽化妝。

reviews.text: Heard so many great things about this product and was excited to finally try it. I’ve only recently started using it, but so far my experience has been positive. Looking forward to seeing more results with continued use and hoping it lives up to the hype!
reviews.zh: 聽咗好多人講呢款產品好好，所以終於好期待試吓。我最近先開始用，不過到目前為止，用落嘅體驗都正面。期待繼續用落去會見到更多效果，希望佢真係名不虛傳！

reviews.text: I've tried it several times, because I had high hopes for this tone up sunscreen. But it gives me uneven white cast and spots, at my hairline it look like I have terrible dandruft 😐. At first I thought it was a skincare product that doesn't go along well, so I've also tried the sunscreen on it's own, but it also gives terrible patchy white cast on my whole face. Disappointed. But I do like the original sunscreen (blue bottle).
reviews.zh: 我試咗好多次，因為我對呢款提亮防曬抱住好大期望。不過佢令我面上出現唔均勻嘅白色痕跡同斑點，喺髮際位置睇落好似有好嚴重嘅頭皮屑 😐。起初我以為係因為同其他護膚品唔夾，所以我都試過單獨用防曬，但係佢都會令我整塊面都出現好差嘅白色斑駁痕跡。好失望。不過我好鍾意原本嘅防曬（藍色樽）。

reviews.text: Es para una amiga por lo que no lo abrí, es un bloqueador líquido, yo he probado lo bloqueadores en barra supongo es un poco más delgado (mas mate sin dejar de ser hidratante). He comprado varios productos de esta marca y nunca decepcionan
reviews.zh: 呢個係買畀朋友嘅，所以我冇打開，係一款液態防曬。我試過啲棒狀防曬，我估呢款應該薄啲（霧面，但仍然保濕）。我買過呢個品牌嘅好多產品，從來冇令我失望。

reviews.text: I had high hopes for the TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream, especially with its brightening claims and SPF protection, but unfortunately, it didn’t work well for my skin. While the texture is light and it applies easily, the main issue is the shiny, almost greasy finish it leaves behind. Instead of a natural or matte tone-up effect, my skin ended up looking oily — even shortly after application. It didn’t absorb well and made layering makeup difficult, as everything started to slide off within a few hours.
reviews.zh: 我對 TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 期望好高，特別係佢嘅提亮效果同 SPF 防護，不過好可惜，佢對我嘅皮膚效果唔好。雖然質地輕盈、好容易推開，但主要問題係佢留低嘅光亮、接近油膩嘅效果。我本來想要自然或者霧面嘅提亮效果，但結果我嘅皮膚睇落好油——甚至係搽完冇幾耐就咁樣。佢吸收得唔好，令疊化妝變得困難，因為幾個鐘頭內嘢就開始脫落。
